# Article

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Article`](gmeow-Article.md)

A written work published in a periodical, blog, or scholarly venue. A specialization of [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Article`](gmeow-Article.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for a written work issued in a periodical, blog, or scholarly venue — a journal paper, news piece, or column at the abstract [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md) tier.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it for a short-form post syndicated to a feed or platform (use [`gmeow:FeedPosting`](gmeow-FeedPosting.md)), and avoid it for the concrete published rendering (a [`gmeow:WebPage`](gmeow-WebPage.md) or PDF [`gmeow:Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md)).

### How to use

- Type the work [`gmeow:Article`](gmeow-Article.md), carry [`gmeow:hasTitle`](../properties/gmeow-hasTitle.md) / [`gmeow:abstract`](../properties/gmeow-abstract.md) / [`gmeow:bibliographicCitation`](../properties/gmeow-bibliographicCitation.md) and the review dates ([`gmeow:dateSubmitted`](../properties/gmeow-dateSubmitted.md), [`gmeow:dateAccepted`](../properties/gmeow-dateAccepted.md)); attribute authorship through the creative-works contribution relator, not a flat author literal.

### Examples

- ex:paper a [`gmeow:Article`](gmeow-Article.md); [`gmeow:hasTitle`](../properties/gmeow-hasTitle.md) ex:paperTitle; [`gmeow:datePublished`](../properties/gmeow-datePublished.md) "2024-03-01T00:00:00Z"^^[xsd:dateTime.](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime.)
